name: The Lake Como EDITION
positioning: A reimagined 19th-century palazzo on the western shore of Lake Como, with contemporary design, a floating pool and a Mauro Colagreco restaurant
best_for: Travelers who want a design-led lakeside stay with Bellagio views
Food lovers drawn to Mauro Colagreco's first restaurant in Italy
Guests who want a spa with a personalized wellness assessment

facts.text: The hotel is on the western shore of Lake Como with views toward Bellagio.
Rooms have custom furnishings by Neri&Hu.
Room interiors use Calacatta marble, bespoke walnut and soft blue tones inspired by the lake.
Many rooms have restored French balconies with views of Lake Como, the Bellagio promontory and the surrounding peaks.
Cetino cooks with hyper-seasonal ingredients and local producers.
The Lobby Bar serves aperitivo beneath five-meter vaulted ceilings.
Spa visits begin with an expert-led assessment of sleep quality, inflammation and oxidative stress.
The hotel offers curated experiences including scenic boat tours and wellness rituals.

highlights.text: Cetino is Mauro Colagreco's first restaurant in Italy.
The hotel reimagines a historic 19th-century palazzo with contemporary design.
The hotel has a floating pool and a private dock with waterfront access.
The spa has an indoor vitality pool with floor-to-ceiling lake views, a steam bath, a herbal sauna and a plunge pool.
Renzo is an all-day restaurant with a pergola-shaded terrace and lake views.

considerations.text: The minimum age for spa access is 18.
A taxi from Lugano Airport crosses the Switzerland-Italy border, and tolls and luggage fees may apply.
WhataHotel notes premium pricing that reflects the luxury positioning.
